description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling popup interactions in SuiteCRM, including closing popups, confirming dialogs, sending data back to parent windows, and toggling additional details display.

methods.name: closePopup
methods.description: Closes the popup window if the parent window has a close popup function.

methods.name: confirmDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to the user, potentially prompting for overwriting address or phone data.

methods.name: send_back
methods.description: Sends selected data back to the parent window, invoking a callback function.

methods.name: send_back_teams
methods.description: Sends selected team data back to the parent window.

methods.name: send_back_selected
methods.description: Sends selected items from a form back to the parent window.

methods.name: toggleMore
methods.description: Displays additional details in a dialog, with caching and asynchronous loading.
